# Top 10 Luxury Family Beach Resorts in Thailand 2026

Thailand remains the ultimate family paradise for luxury travelers in 2026. With its warm hospitality, pristine beaches, and world-class amenities, the Land of Smiles offers an unmatched blend of relaxation and adventure for families. Whether you’re traveling with toddlers, tweens, or teenagers, these ten resorts have perfected the art of family luxury. From dedicated kids clubs with Thai cooking classes to sprawling family suites with private pools, here is our curated list of the top luxury family beach resorts in Thailand for 2026.

## Four Seasons Koh Samui

Perched on the northwestern tip of Koh Samui, Four Seasons Koh Samui is a sanctuary of tropical elegance. The resort’s family villas are designed with privacy and space in mind, featuring separate living areas and plunge pools. The **Kids for All Seasons** club offers daily activities from 9 AM to 9 PM, including Thai language lessons, coconut art, and snorkeling safaris. For dining, the resort provides a dedicated children’s menu at all restaurants, with healthy options like grilled fish and organic vegetables. Beach safety is paramount: lifeguards patrol the calm, shallow waters of Laem Yai Bay from 8 AM to 6 PM. Family packages for 2026 include the **“Family Escape”** starting at $1,200 (THB 43,000) per night for a two-bedroom villa with breakfast, airport transfers, and a complimentary half-day kids club. Prices range from $900 to $2,500 per night (THB 32,000–90,000).

## Amanpuri Phuket

Amanpuri, the flagship of the Aman brand, redefines family luxury on Phuket’s west coast. The resort offers multi-bedroom pavilions and private villas with butler service, perfect for families seeking exclusivity. The **Aman Kids Club** focuses on cultural immersion, with activities like batik painting, Thai boxing classes, and beach ecology walks. Dining is a highlight: the resort’s private chef can prepare custom meals for children, and the **Aman Family Picnic** on Pansea Beach includes gourmet bento boxes and fresh fruit. Beach safety includes a dedicated children’s swimming area with gentle waves and full-time lifeguards. The **“Family Journey”** package for 2026 starts at $2,000 (THB 72,000) per night for a two-bedroom pavilion, including daily breakfast, afternoon tea, and a private family excursion. Rates range from $1,500 to $4,000 per night (THB 54,000–144,000).

## Soneva Kiri

On the remote island of Koh Kood, Soneva Kiri is a dream for families who love nature and adventure. The resort’s overwater and beachfront villas feature private pools, slides, and outdoor bathrooms. The **Soneva Kiri Kids Club** is legendary, with a dedicated Den staffed by “GEMs” (Guest Experience Managers) who organize treasure hunts, stargazing, and sustainable gardening. The resort’s **Cinema Paradiso** offers family movie nights under the stars. Dining includes a children’s menu at all outlets, plus the famous **So Chilled** ice cream parlor with 60+ flavors. Beach safety is taken seriously: the private bay has a gentle slope and lifeguards on duty. The **“Family Adventure”** package starts at $2,500 (THB 90,000) per night for a one-bedroom villa, including all meals, non-alcoholic drinks, and unlimited kids club access. Rates range from $1,800 to $5,000 per night (THB 65,000–180,000).

## Banyan Tree Samui

Nestled on the cliffs of Lamai Bay, Banyan Tree Samui offers stunning ocean views and family-friendly villas with private infinity pools. The **Banyan Tree Kids Club** caters to ages 4–12 with Thai puppet-making, sandcastle competitions, and eco-tours. The resort’s **Saffron** restaurant has a dedicated children’s menu with Thai classics like pad Thai and mango sticky rice. Beach safety is excellent: the resort’s private beach has a roped-off swimming area and lifeguards. The **“Family Bliss”** package for 2026 includes a two-bedroom villa with breakfast, a family photo session, and a sunset cruise, starting at $1,100 (THB 40,000) per night. Rates range from $800 to $2,200 per night (THB 29,000–79,000).

## Six Senses Yao Noi

On the island of Yao Noi in Phang Nga Bay, Six Senses Yao Noi combines rustic luxury with family fun. The resort’s hilltop and beachfront villas feature outdoor showers and private pools. The **Grow Room** kids club offers organic gardening, cooking classes, and rock climbing. Dining includes a children’s menu at **The Dining Room**, with options like homemade pizza and smoothies. Beach safety is a priority: the resort’s main beach has a gentle slope and lifeguards. The **“Family Time”** package starts at $1,300 (THB 47,000) per night for a one-bedroom villa, including breakfast, a family excursion, and daily kids club. Rates range from $1,000 to $3,000 per night (THB 36,000–108,000).

## Rosewood Phuket

Rosewood Phuket on Emerald Bay is a masterpiece of modern luxury. The resort’s family pavilions and villas are spacious, with private pools and butler service. The **Rosewood Explorers** kids club offers Thai arts, cooking classes, and beach games. Dining is exceptional: **Ta Khai** serves family-style Thai meals, and the resort’s **Beach House** has a children’s menu. Beach safety includes a protected swimming area and full-time lifeguards. The **“Family Escape”** package for 2026 starts at $1,600 (THB 58,000) per night for a one-bedroom pavilion with breakfast and kids club access. Rates range from $1,200 to $3,500 per night (THB 43,000–126,000).

## InterContinental Phuket

Located on Kamala Beach, InterContinental Phuket is a sprawling resort with a dedicated **Kids Club** (ages 4–12) featuring a water playground, craft room, and outdoor cinema. The resort’s family suites are connected, offering flexibility for larger families. Dining options include **Pine Beach Bar** with a children’s menu and **Jaras** for Thai fine dining. Beach safety is excellent with lifeguards and a calm bay. The **“Family Fun”** package starts at $800 (THB 29,000) per night for a family suite, including breakfast and a daily kids club session. Rates range from $600 to $1,800 per night (THB 22,000–65,000).

## JW Marriott Phuket

JW Marriott Phuket on Mai Khao Beach is a family favorite for its massive pool complex and **JW Kids Club**. The club offers Thai dance lessons, snorkeling, and eco-activities. The resort’s family rooms are spacious, and the **Sala Rasmi** restaurant has a dedicated children’s buffet. Beach safety is top-notch with lifeguards and a designated swimming area. The **“Family Getaway”** package starts at $700 (THB 25,000) per night for a family room, including breakfast and kids club. Rates range from $500 to $1,500 per night (THB 18,000–54,000).

## Anantara Mai Khao

Anantara Mai Khao on Phuket’s north coast offers family pool villas with private pools and outdoor living. The **Anantara Kids Club** is open daily with activities like Thai boxing, cooking, and beach games. Dining includes the **Sea.Fire.Salt.** restaurant with a children’s menu and live cooking stations. Beach safety is ensured by lifeguards and a gentle shoreline. The **“Family Escape”** package starts at $900 (THB 32,000) per night for a one-bedroom pool villa, including breakfast and kids club. Rates range from $700 to $2,000 per night (THB 25,000–72,000).

## Phulay Bay Ritz-Carlton Reserve

Phulay Bay in Krabi is a Ritz-Carlton Reserve that offers unparalleled family luxury. The resort’s villas feature private pools and outdoor showers. The **Ritz Kids** program focuses on Thai culture, with activities like fruit carving and long-tail boat rides. Dining at **Jampoon** includes a children’s menu with organic options. Beach safety is excellent with a protected bay and lifeguards. The **“Family Reserve”** package starts at $1,400 (THB 50,000) per night for a one-bedroom villa, including breakfast and a daily kids club. Rates range from $1,000 to $3,000 per night (THB 36,000–108,000).

---

**Final Thoughts**

These ten resorts represent the pinnacle of family luxury in Thailand for 2026. Each property offers exceptional kids clubs, spacious family suites, thoughtful dining options, and stringent beach safety measures. Whether you choose the serene shores of Koh Samui or the vibrant beaches of Phuket, your family will create memories that last a lifetime.
